entries.title: A panel can change the settings you allow it
entries.body: A panel can now change settings such as the theme, the text size, your crew's models, a project's settings or an automation, the same way your first mate does. It changes one only when you click or press a key in it, one change at a time, and Activity names the panel. A panel added from elsewhere lists each setting it may change on its approval card before you add it. Signing in, sharing, consent and deleting things stay out of reach.
entries.noPicture: What a person sees comes from each panel's own controls, which this change does not draw; the approval card only gains a list of the settings a panel names.
